reason: Both operate in US online and campus higher education, with nursing/healthcare programs. APEI runs its own accredited universities and sells degree programs directly to students, and also to military and veteran learners. GCE is a shared-services provider to partner universities (enrollment, marketing, technology, academic support) and earns fees from those universities. The end market overlaps, but the product and the direct buyer differ. That makes it adjacent, not a direct competitor.
